collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A fisher wonders whether there could be people who live so far from the sea that they have never seen a wave.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a fisher, wonders whether there could be people who live so far from the sea that they have never seen a wave.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The fisher imagines someone seeing the sea for the first time and weeping with joy; the idea moves the listeners.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A child imagines them being frightened by the noise and hiding from the waves.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: An elder suggests that land without sea might have wonders Isolans have never imagined, like rivers wider than the lagoon.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A skeptic says such a place sounds dry and dull, and a scholar reminds them that "dull" is a guess too.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A cook imagines meals with no fish at all and is quietly horrified.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A farmer says they might grow grains and roots, just like Isolan gardens, only more.
